title: Retry, Switch, or Abstain? Learning Strategy-Aware Tool-Use Policies via Controlled Error Injection
abstract: arXiv:2608.11977v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tool-using LLM agents are commonly trained and evaluated in environments where tool calls succeed reliably, yet deployed tools can fail transiently, persistently, or silently. Robust recovery therefore requires more than repeated retries: an agent may need to retry the same path, switch to an alternative, or recognize that no viable path remains. We present BENCH2ROBUST, a framework that converts failure-free tool-use benchmarks into controlled stochastic environments with scenario-controlled solvability, where episodes explicitly require retrying, switching, or stopping after available paths are exhausted. We use BENCH2ROBUST to study two complementary interventions: structured runtime recovery context through Bayesian Tool Memory (BTM), and curriculum-controlled reinforcement learning. Across 7 models from 4 families and two multi-turn benchmark families, tool failures produce a near-universal robustness gap. On held-out Retail tasks,

translated_title: 重试、切换或放弃？通过受控错误注入学习策略感知的工具使用策略
translated_abstract: 使用工具的LLM代理通常在工具调用可靠成功的环境中进行训练和评估，但实际部署的工具可能会暂时性、持续性或静默地失败。因此，稳健的恢复不仅仅需要重复重试：代理可能需要重试相同路径、切换到替代方案，或认识到没有可行路径可继续。我们提出了BENCH2ROBUST框架，该框架将无故障的工具使用基准转换为具有场景控制可解性的受控随机环境，其中情节明确要求重试、切换或在可用路径耗尽后停止。我们使用BENCH2ROBUST研究两种互补干预措施：通过贝叶斯工具记忆（BTM）的结构化运行时恢复上下文，以及课程控制的强化学习。在来自4个家族的7个模型和两个多轮基准家族中，工具故障产生了近乎普遍的鲁棒性差距。在保留的零售任务上，
tldr: 本文提出BENCH2ROBUST框架，通过受控错误注入和策略感知学习（结合贝叶斯工具记忆与课程强化学习），使工具使用LLM代理在工具故障时能自适应地重试、切换或放弃，显著提升鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces BENCH2ROBUST, a framework that uses controlled error injection and strategy-aware learning (with Bayesian Tool Memory and curriculum RL) to enable tool-using LLM agents to adaptively retry, switch, or abstain under tool failures, significantly improving robustness.
